title: The Hollow King
changes: New final story, The Hollow Crown: once the Gloam, the Pale Marshal and the Redfang Debt are done, Elder Rowan has one last task (Lv 24+).
Follow the King's Way from the forest shrine to the Hollow Throne, far north-east, and break its three ward-stones.
Face Ostrevar, the Hollow King, a Lv 30 boss: Crown Cleave, Gloam Pools, servants from the grave and Crown's Wrath. Watch the ground!
He drops three pieces of top-grade gear.
